name: TheBellyDanceDressingRoom
description: TheBellyDanceDressingRoom is an App developed by Laniakea Bellydancer LLC to help dancers around the world to buy and sell dresses in a centralized manner. About me: I am Laniakea Bellydancer, a Puerto Rican artist based in Maryland, USA. I love gigging and I understand the importance of getting new costumes to support all performance needs!
